- imports: Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Epi, Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Ring.Epi, S1747, S1786, S1793.

WHAT IS PROVED (all in namespace S1797)
1. theorem epiSurjective : S1747.EpiSurjective K.
   Proof (no product decomposition needed): make A a B-algebra via phi; then Algebra.Etale B A
   (Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars) and Module.Finite B A
   (Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite). The test algebra A (x)_B A is finite etale over K
   (Etale.baseChange + Etale.comp, Module.Finite.base_change + Module.Finite.trans); applying the
   epi hypothesis to Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft/includeRight gives 1 (x) a = a (x) 1,
   i.e. Algebra.IsEpi B A; Mathlib's Algebra.isEpi_iff_surjective_algebraMap_of_finite
   (Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Epi) then gives surjectivity of phi.
2. theorem prod_surjective_split : product-of-fields form (surjective psi : prod Bj -> prod Ai,
   Ai,Bj fields, finite/separable) splits as prod Bj ~= prod Ai x C.
   Uses Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod, S1747.exists_factor, injectivity of the index map
   ji, complement C = prod_{j not in range ji} Bj, and an explicit right inverse.
3. theorem surjectiveSplit : S1747.SurjectiveSplit K (decompose A and B via iff_exists_algEquiv_prod,
   transport through eA,eB, apply 2).
4. theorem finiteEtaleSplit : S1786.FiniteEtaleSplit K.
5. theorem monoInducesIsoOnDirectSummandField : S1786.MonoInducesIsoOnDirectSummandField K
   (via S1786.monoInducesIsoOnDirectSummand_of_epiSurjective_of_surjectiveSplit), plus
   ..._S1767 and ..._S1793 (literal shapes; definitionally equal).
6. theorem preGaloisCategory : PreGaloisCategory (S1793GaloisAssembly.FiniteEtaleAlg K) with NO
   hypotheses (S1793's assembly with the G3 slot filled); preGaloisCategory_op gives the same at
   ((CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{0} K)^op).
7. theorem galoisCategory : still conditional only on S1793's FiberFunctorField (geometric fibre
   functor); nothing about the fibre functor was assumed or faked.

AXIOM AUDIT (in-file #print axioms, see compile log): every one of the eight main declarations
depends on exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; in particular NO sorryAx.
Extra verification: downstream file _S1797Check.lean imports the new olean and proves the
S1747/S1786/S1793 statements at K = Q, instantiates PreGaloisCategory ((CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale Q)^op)
and extracts its G3 field; EXIT=0.

  ledger was rewritten except removing stray backslash-backtick escapes).

  _S1797Dev.lean, _S1797Check.lean (+ .log files).
- Reusable gotcha for other sessions: destructuring Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod and
  re-registering the Pi-type instances with haveI/letI yields instance terms that are not
  definitionally equal to those the dependent data was stated with; the workaround (used here) is
  a product-level lemma with genuine instance binders, applied with @ and the destructured
  terms supplied explicitly.
